Maya (Marketing): Partner enablement ask: compact battlecard + inbound routing that surfaces high-cost risk and partner leads. Need: 1-page AE + partner slide, 2-line SDR hooks, and HubSpot/partner-routing rules.
Dev (Product): Callouts: stable p95 under burst, identical API across hosted/dedicated/private, and operational knobs (batching, prefix cache, quant profiles). I'll drop a microbench snippet.
Rafi (Sales): SDR hooks (very short):
- "Curious what your inference bill looks like as users grow?"
- "We make serving predictable across clouds and on-prem."
I'll make partner-friendly variants.
June (Growth): Routing prototype (for ops/partner portal):
```
score = 0.6*norm(est_tokens)+0.3*norm(company.revenue)+0.1*(role=='engineer')
if (score>0.85) route='solutions-engineering' // AE + partner handoff
else if (score>0.45) route='high-touch-sales'
else route='partner-nurture'
```
We capture est_tokens hidden on forms and a checkbox for "partner-intro".
se-bot: Note: partner demo infra booked Fri 10:00 PT. Canary deploy ok.
Maya (Marketing): Webinar follow-up asset: quick cost calc + one-pager battlecard for partners that has 4 bullets: perf, cost delta vs managed API, deployment parity, rollback/fallback story. Add partner play: introduce SE if score>0.85.
Dev (Product): Microbench will include table header: [env, seq_len, p95_ms, cost_per_1M_tokens]. Will annotate hardware and caveats (batch policy, quant).
Rafi (Sales): Partner slide one-liner: "Redwood: predictable serving across environments so your customers ship reliably." Thoughts?
June (Growth): CTA experiments: "See your estimated cost" vs "Request partner intro". For partner referrals auto-add tag and create task for partner success.
Maya (Marketing): Owners: Dev -> battlecard + microbench; Rafi -> SDR lines + partner slide; June -> routing + mapping; Maya -> webinar follow-up copy + asset pack. Drafts by Tue EOD.
Dev (Product): I'll also include a short note vs infra vendors: we provide tuned runtime + orchestration so partners don't re-do kernel tuning.
Rafi (Sales): I'll add 3 procurement bullets: pricing models (usage + reserved), SLA tiers, private deployment options. Keep them 2 lines.
Maya (Marketing): Perfect. I'll compile and post draft link here when ready. :sparkles:
